Package com.workshop.mcp.spec

Class MetaKeys

java.lang.Object
com.workshop.mcp.spec.MetaKeys
public final class MetaKeys extends Object
The _meta keys that carry the stateless lifecycle of protocol revision 2026-07-28.

Revision 2026-07-28 removed the initialize handshake. There is no longer a moment at which the client and server agree on a protocol version and exchange capabilities once; instead every single request re-states them inside params._meta, and every result identifies its sender the same way. These constants name those slots.

Since:
1.0
